sections.title: Making a decision
sections.content: választ ("to choose, to select") takes the accusative, just like keres and talál. biztos ("sure, certain") describes how confident you feel about the choice — Biztos vagyok is "I'm sure", no verb needed for the second half beyond vagyok.

items.spanish: Biztos vagyok, hogy ez a jó méret.
items.english: I'm sure this is the right size.

items.spanish: Nem vagyok biztos, melyik pulóver olyan olcsó, mint a zöld.
items.english: I'm not sure which sweater is as cheap as the green one.

sections.content: melyik ("which one") is from A1's demonstratives — it slots straight into a sentence with választ or biztos the same way it always has.
